lines.text: I have too much to do.

data.mean: I have too much to do.
data.define: Used to say you are extremely busy with work or tasks.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm swamped' when you're bored.
misuse.why: It means too much to do.

publish.title: What does "I'm swamped" mean?
publish.value: I'm swamped = I have too much to do. Example: "Sorry, I'm swamped with homework." (casual English).
